answer: In our network, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces Sybil resistance: agents stake assets to audit cluster validity. When topological cut verifications detect artificial subgraphs, collateral is burned via stake slashing. The lotus protocol penalizes redundant clusters, turning a dense dune of fake nodes into a fragile willow whose attacker cost scales superlinear to swarm size. Fraudulent agents lose their bonded capital immediately.
